definitions.explanation: Pollock or cod roe marinated in chili pepper and other seasonings. A specialty of Fukuoka (Hakata) and one of Japan's most popular rice accompaniments and onigiri fillings. The unseasoned version is called たらこ.

examples.japanese: {明太子|めんたいこ}のおにぎりが{好|す}きだ。
{博多|はかた}は{明太子|めんたいこ}の{本場|ほんば}として{有名|ゆうめい}だ。
examples.english: Hakata is famous as the home of mentaiko.

examples.japanese: {明太子|めんたいこ}パスタは{日本|にほん}{発祥|はっしょう}の{人気|にんき}メニューで、{多|おお}くのレストランで{提供|ていきょう}されている。
examples.english: Mentaiko pasta is a popular dish originating in Japan, served at many restaurants.

notes:
USAGE:
{明太子|めんたいこ} specifically refers to spicy seasoned pollock roe. The unseasoned version is たらこ ({鱈子|たらこ}). The name comes from Korean: {明太|めんたい} is the Korean word for pollock (명태), and {子|こ} means roe. {博多|はかた} ({福岡|ふくおか}) is credited with popularizing the modern spicy version.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {明太子|めんたいこ}おにぎり: mentaiko rice ball
- {明太子|めんたいこ}パスタ: mentaiko pasta
- {辛子|からし}{明太子|めんたいこ}: spicy mentaiko (formal/full name)
- {博多|はかた}{明太子|めんたいこ}: Hakata mentaiko (brand origin)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- たらこ: unseasoned pollock roe (plain, salted)
- {明太子|めんたいこ}: spicy seasoned pollock roe (chili-marinated)
